passage:
"Pani puri after work? My treat," Maria said, leaning on Dilnaz's cubicle. "Yes! 😊 Give me ten minutes."
"Okay, also, did you hear who is being moved to the Delhi team?"
"I did, but Kavita told me in confidence, so I'm not repeating it. Even to you."
Maria laughed, a little embarrassed. "Fair. I'd want you to do the same with mine."
"Exactly. And hey, Farhan is new and sits alone at lunch. Should we ask him along on Friday?"
"Just the two of us has been so nice, though."
"It still will be. We can do both." Dilnaz grinned and saved her file.
"Fine, fine. Ten minutes. Bring your umbrella, it looks like rain."

qa.q: What did Maria offer to buy after work?
qa.a: Maria offered pani puri as a treat.

qa.q: Why did Dilnaz refuse to say who was moving to the Delhi team?
qa.a: Kavita told her in confidence, so she wants to keep that trust even with a friend.

qa.q: How does Dilnaz keep the friendship from becoming a clique?
qa.a: She suggests inviting Farhan, who is new and sits alone at lunch, while still keeping time for the two of them.

qa.q: How might Maria feel about being told no on the secret?
qa.a: Maria is a little embarrassed, but the reply about wanting the same shows Maria understands and may trust Dilnaz more.

grounding: A colleague becomes a close friend while keeping confidences and avoiding a clique.
